paragraphs: Info Page
We offer the following over the counter services

sections.heading: Permit Center Hours of Operation
paragraphs: Monday: 9:00 am - 5:00 pm
Tuesday-Friday: 8:00 am - 5:00 pm

sections.heading: Over the Counter (OTC) without Plans
paragraphs: Submit your over-the-counter no plans project in person. Remember to bring your application and completed forms with supporting documents with you. Each customer may submit a maximum of two OTC No Plans applications per review. Email DBI techq@sfgov.org if you are uncertain whether your project requires plans. Additional information on OTC projects is found here.

sections.heading: Over the Counter (OTC) with Plans
paragraphs: We offer drop-in service for Over the Counter (OTC) with plans projects.
The Permit Center will no longer offer the ability to schedule appointments. Just drop-in!
Each customer may submit a maximum of one application per review.
Click here for a list of the forms required by DBI and other permitting departments. Additional information on OTC projects is found here.

sections.heading: Over the Counter (OTC) Fire-Only
paragraphs: Submit your OTC fire and life safety projects by following the above OTC with plans process.
For additional questions: firesafety@sfgov.org
Or visit: SFFD Plan Review

sections.heading: Trade Permits (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing and Solar)
paragraphs: Apply for the following Trade Permit online if you are a licensed contractor with an online DBI account :
Electrical
Plumbing and Mechanical
Boiler Permit to Operate
Reroofing
Kitchen/Bath Remodel
You may also apply in person, an appointment is not required. Limit 3 applications per review.
Email DBI for additional questions: dbicustomerservice@sfgov.org
Of visit: SF DBI

sections.heading: Technical Services Division (DBI)
paragraphs: General questions and assistance with the San Francisco Building Code.
*Counter Hours; Mon, Tues, Thur, Fri: 7:30 AM to 11:30 AM; Weds 9:00 AM to 11:30 AM
Contact by email for assistance at techq@sfgov.org

sections.heading: Key Programs Counter (DBI)
paragraphs: Form submittal for the following programs, please contact the programs directly if you have questions:

Accessory Dwelling Unit Program (ADU) pic@sfgov.org , Mandatory Soft Story Program softstory@sfgov.org , Building Occupancy Resumption Program (BORP) dbicustomerservice@sfgov.org , Building Façade Inspection and Maintenance dbi.facade@sfgov.org , Unit Legalization unitlegalization@sfgov.org .

sections.heading: SF Public Works (BSM)
paragraphs: BSM provides the following Over the Counter (OTC) construction services in person.
Street Space permit
Sidewalk Repair permit
Inspection Right-of-Way Conformity
General BSM permitting questions
Acceptance of documents for a permit under review (Bonds, insurance, etc)
Acceptance of payments for permits via check or credit card. Cash will not be accepted.
Limit 3 applications per review
In-house and commercial permits for BSM are only accepted via the online portal /email and will not be accepted at the Permit Center.
Email Public Works for additional questions: streetspace@sfdpw.org
Or visit SF Public Works

sections.heading: SF Public Works Urban Forestry (BUF)
paragraphs: BUF provides the following services and permits.
All applications for tree planting, tree removal, sidewalk landscaping, and tree protection will be accepted. Online submission is preferred
In some cases, tree planting and landscaping can be issued OTC. Email for questions.
Payment accepted for all invoices issued by the BUF; application fees for applications that have already been submitted
General inquiries and questions
Permits Not Issued OTC and accepted via online/email/ by phone:
Tree Removal: Requires physical inspection and notice
Email: urbanforestry@sfdpw.org Phone: 628-652-8773

sections.heading: SF Planning Consultation Services
paragraphs: SF Planning provides in-person consultation service for the following:
General Land Use and Zoning
Design Review
SF Planning Code
Neighborhood plan or area plan
General questions and assistance
An appointment is not required.
Email SF Planning for additional questions: pic@sfgov.org
Or visit: SF Planning

sections.heading: SF Department of Public Health (DPH)
paragraphs: SF DPH provides the following services at the Permit Center. An appointment is not required.
* Environmental Health OTC plan review; weekdays: 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM
Environmental Health in-person general assistance is available during the Permit Center's hours of operation.
Applications and payments
Appointments
General questions
Email SF DPH for additional questions: EnvHealth.DPH@sfdph.org
Or visit: SF DPH Environmental Health

sections.heading: SF Recreation and Park Department (RPD)
paragraphs: SF RPD provides the following services at the Permit Center: • Picnic Site Reservations • Athletic Field Reservations (occasional/single day only) • Proof of Residency Verification for Athletic Field Reservations • Payment Processing (Check or Credit Card Only) • Consultations All permits are available online at sfrecpark.org
*Service Hours: Monday through Friday 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, with the exception of holidays
Telephone Assistance, (415) 831-5500 Monday through Friday 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM, with the exception of City holidays
Email: RPDReservations@sfgov.org

sections.heading: Office of Small Business (OSB)
paragraphs: OSB provides the following services at the Permit Center: • Field permitting inquiries from small businesses and route customers to the appropriate agencies for additional support • Assist customers with understanding overall journey for their permitting needs • Serve as main point of contact for customers who require services from several agencies • Provide proactive follow-up and updates to customers • Provide general small business assistance on City resources • Organizing and coordinating information sessions (virtual or in-person) on frequently asked permitting questions for small businesses
Email: sfosb@sfgov.org
